key_insight: PaddleMaterials unifies six materials-learning task classes into verifiable workflows while supporting compiled execution without changing model definitions.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can connect materials generation, relaxation and property analysis through shared infrastructure with explicit physical quantities, units and reference conventions.
method: Unify data processing, training, evaluation and pretrained-model management across six task classes.
Record scientific semantics in task interfaces to verify cross-task composition.
Enable compiled execution through one setting using graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted code generation.
evidence_signal: Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compilation accelerated every instance in eight groups; LiMnO2 formation-energy predictions differed from same-geometry PBE+U references by at most 7 meV/atom, with model-step costs below one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation.
watch_item: Compilation gains were not universal across all groups, and the reported case studies do not establish accuracy across broader material chemistries.
paper_title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
